Rotate into US-listed AI enablers and Taiwan semis; set stop-losses at 5% below entry.

themes: US AI data-center power demand is structurally re-rating independent power producers and solar-plus-storage names, creating durable outperformance versus Indonesian utilities tied to slower PLN dispat

Global solar module oversupply is compressing margins for Indonesian manufacturers, pushing value toward downstream O&M and battery integration rather than upstream production.
sectors.ai: US-listed renewables names are leading on policy momentum and AI-driven power demand, while Indonesian exposure lags on domestic regulatory friction. Rotate into US solar and storage names (FSLR, SEDG, ENPH) for near-term beta, but build Indonesian positions selectively around geothermal and biomass where tariffs and PPAs are stabilizing. Regulatory stability and food-security policies are creating a supportive backdrop for domestic consumer manufacturers, reducing input-cost volatility and boosting margin predictability.
sectors.ai: Buy selective mid-cap FMCG names with confirmed volume breakouts (JELI, IATA, BACH) while avoiding large-cap laggards; the sector's mild aggregate gain masks strong rotational momentum into smaller consumer plays. Position for 2-4 week continuation as US-listed peers (+0.46%) confirm demand, but trim into any 15%+ single-day spikes to lock gains.
